sections.heading: Maria Van Kerkhove — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Maria Van Kerkhove was born on 20 February 1977 in New Hartford, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Maria Rosanne DeJoseph at birth and is publicly known as Maria Van Kerkhove.
She studied at London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, Stanford University School of Medicine and Cornell University.
